$comment: ZCode workspace configuration. Adapted from the original Claude Code settings.json (preserved verbatim at .zcode/settings.json.claude-original). Key ZCode differences: (1) no `permissions` block exists — tool gating is per-skill/per-command `allowed-tools`, not a global allow/deny; (2) hooks are nested under `hooks.events.<Event>` and require `hooks.enabled: true`; (3) ZCode supports only 7 hook events — the original Notification, PreCompact, and SessionStart(compact|resume) hooks are dropped here; (4) env var is $ZCODE_PROJECT_DIR (the Claude name still works but ZCODE_ is canonical).
